notes: Edition 1 national standard, identical (translation) adoption of ISO/IEC 20546:2019 — matches the owner's expectation (INSO 23683, year 1403, ISO/IEC 20546:2019); no difference found. Standard is a vocabulary/overview standard: clause 1 scope, clause 2 (no normative references), clause 3 (38 terms in 3.1 + 3 abbreviations in 3.2), clause 4 key characteristics of big data, informative Annex A (cross-cutting concepts), bibliography. It contains no «باید» (shall) statements, no tables or figures, and does not discuss AI, machine learning, big data roles/activities or an analytics lifecycle beyond the definitions of data analytics (3.1.6), data science (3.1.10, 4.3.1) and benefit (3.1.1, 4.3.4). Only a committee member's affiliation (pdf 4) contains the words «هوش مصنوعی».
uncertainties: Clause numbers are printed visually mirrored (RTL); recorded in logical order (see terms.json clause_numbering_note).
Several internal cross-references do not match the printed numbering (3.1.19, 3.1.22, 3.1.26, 3.1.31, 3.1.32, 4.3.1) — see uncertainties.md; may be inherited from the source text, not verified.
Persian terminology is inconsistent between entries (scatter/gather, structured/semi-structured, کلان‌داده/بزرگ‌داده, محاسبات ابری/رایانش ابری, «بدیل» in the introduction) — see uncertainties.md.
Standard contains no «باید»; «ضروری است»/«الزامی است» occur in descriptive text and are recorded as info.
